scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,SOCKET,ADMIN -c green,cyan,magenta "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm --filter socket start" "pnpm dev:admin"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter socket test && pnpm --filter socket exec tsx --test ../../packages/ui/src/locale.test.ts ../web/tests/analytics.test.ts && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs apps/web/tests/server-pages.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --incremental false -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/socket/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter 2048-admin typecheck
